steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Euthanasia means "good death" — it is the deliberate ending of a person's life to end suffering. It is illegal in the UK. Religious views are shaped by beliefs about the sanctity of life and the afterlife. | RS Exam Tips — Euthanasia and the Afterlife: 1. For Euthanasia and the Afterlife questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
